decisions.reason: 传奇比赛 is the named player-facing mode Legend Race, so the embedded generic 比赛→Cuộc đua lock appears over-broad inside this compound proper name. A systemic context rule should be fixed before changing the mode label.
decisions.terminology_basis: Current text preserves the established Legend Race name; embedded race.generic conflicts only because 比赛 is nested inside the named mode.

canonical_finding.concept: Generic race versus Legend Race named mode
canonical_finding.reason: race.generic must not require Cuộc đua when 比赛 occurs as part of the named compound 传奇比赛/Legend Race; named-mode context needs exclusion or higher-priority proper-name handling.

decisions.reason: 传奇比赛 is the named Legend Race mode; forcing generic Cuộc đua into the compound would corrupt the mode name. Defer until generic-race matching excludes this proper-name context.
